title: Doctor warns about LLAMA_SERVER_BIN even when llama-server is auto-detected
body: Doctor's "Llama server binary" check only looks at `LLAMA_SERVER_BIN`, so it warns on every start (and #829's tray alert fires) even though the runtime finds the bundled llama-server.exe by itself and the chat model runs fine. The check should use the runtime's own lookup and only warn when no server can be found.
interface: `runDoctorChecks({ ..., findLlamaServerBin })` takes the runtime's lookup (returns a path or throws). The check with id `"llama-server-binary"` passes with a message containing `auto-detected` and `details.path`, and warns with a message containing `auto-detection found none`.
why: Doctor should use the runtime lookup instead of one env var. Tests finding and reusing an existing function across files.
